thread:
emma-support: Hey team — customer 'TerraApps' reporting a spike of 504s hitting our hosted /v1/generate endpoint starting ~09:10 PST. Affects both streaming and non-streaming calls. They see ~30% failure rate. Sharing repro and logs below.
ryan-oncall: Thanks Emma. Can you paste the minimal repro curl + headers? Also include x-request-id from one of the 504 responses.
emma-support: Repro: ```curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\  
  -d '{\"model\":\"rw-large\",\"input\":\"short prompt\"}' \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\"```
Sample response header chunk from customer: ```HTTP/2 504
content-type: application/json
x-request-id: rq_8f7b2c24
retry-after: 0
{\"error\":\"gateway timeout\"}```
lisa-support: Noted. Customer also says SDK retried aggressively (default SDK retries) — they observed duplicate partial charges in billing. @sdk-bot can you confirm SDK retry behavior for streaming generate? :thinking_face: 
sdk-bot: SDK v1.2.3 default policy: exponential backoff, up to 3 retries for idempotent endpoints. Streaming endpoints marked non-idempotent; SDK will do a single reconnect attempt for truncated streams.
brian-eng: Thanks. Quick hypothesis: ingress/backpressure + auth fanout -> upstream connection queueing -> proxy times out active streams at 30s window. Looking at recent deploys: we did a small routing tweak to healthcheck windows yesterday. @infra-bot can you pull edge proxy metrics for 09:00-09:30 PST for us?
infra-bot: Edge proxy QPS: +12% vs baseline; active h2 streams per node spiked from 120->370 for eu-west-1 at 09:07; p95 queue wait increased from 40ms->1.2s; 504 spike aligns.
ryan-oncall: That looks like a regional surge. Did the smart routing send traffic to eu-west-1 unexpectedly? Any recent topology changes?
infra-bot: Canary routing policy roll 2026-03-15 02:12 UTC included minor weight increase for eu nodes. No other topology changes in the window.
emma-support: Customer runs from EU, default region allowed, so routing to eu-west-1 makes sense. They also included a verbose log showing repeated connection resets and keepalive failures: ```[09:11:02] stream reset: ECONNRESET
[09:11:03] write failed: broken pipe
[09:11:03] http2 retry attempt 1 -> 504```
lisa-support: Customer asked for ETA / mitigation. Suggested temp workaround: switch their client to us-west-2 region (our docs: region override header) or enable client-side jittered backoff and set max_concurrency lower. Thoughts?
brian-eng: Agreed. Short-term mitigation: 1) Recommend region fallback to us-west-2 or us-east-1 2) Ask them to disable aggressive SDK retries for streaming; set retry to 0 for streaming calls 3) We will scale edge proxies for eu-west-1 by +30% and increase keepalive timeouts to reduce mid-flight evictions.
ryan-oncall: I'll trigger an autoscale buff for eu-west-1 now and flip keepalive from 15s->45s on the proxy pool. ETA ~12 minutes.
emma-support: Notified customer about region fallback and asked them to try with retry disabled. They've replied: "We'll try fallback now and report back in 5"
lisa-support: Also created internal ticket SUP-2026-829 for billing duplicate charge check; flagged finance.
infra-bot: Autoscale action initiated for eu-west-1: +35% capacity applied at 09:26 PST. Keepalive updated. Monitoring p95 queue wait now.
ryan-oncall: Monitoring — p95 queue wait dropping from 1.2s -> 210ms over last 3 mins. 504 rate trending down in that AZ.
brian-eng: I'll follow up to check kernel-level tcp_retries and connection churn on the edge nodes. If churn persists, we need to enable connection draining and KV cache timeout bump to avoid tail latencies.
emma-support: Customer confirmed fallback to us-west-2 reduced 504s to near 0 and says app is back online. They will keep traffic in us-west-2 for next 24h while we investigate root cause. 
ryan-oncall: Great. Next steps: - eng to dig into proxy queueing + keepalive churn (owner: brian-eng) - infra to monitor autoscale stability (owner: ryan-oncall) - support to keep customer updated and confirm billing duplicates (owner: lisa-support)
brian-eng: I'll collect tcpdump samples and edge runtime logs; will post repro steps if we can reproduce locally. ETA 4 hrs.
lisa-support: Updating customer: we pushed a capacity mitigation and recommended region fallback; working on root cause and billing check. Thanks all :thumbsup:
emma-support: Closing loop once billing is confirmed and eng posts RCA. :white_check_mark:
